question: Can the frozen routed-v6 policy amplify a validated whole-turn beam search by cheaply simulating complete opponent replies to the root beam's distinct candidate turns, instead of repeatedly training a direct action head that failed autonomous gates?
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, all seats, action limit2400, deterministic matched maps
frozen_policy: Routed-v6 source SHA256 68549a5af87e4d2d065a164e39bc515c2c1d48276f437494d757e25c3ef28867, routed for procedural_v1 as in prior two-player studies; no retraining, checkpoint choice or terminal oracle
hybrid_agent: At the start of each root turn, generate native beam256's top8 distinct completed-turn plans including its greedy fallback. From each exact post-root candidate state, independently let the frozen policy take argmax legal actions for the opponent's complete turn, with maximum24 atomic actions; evaluate the resulting game using native root-perspective position_score. Select the candidate with maximal (predicted reply score, native root static score, negative original rank), then execute and cache that entire root plan as local legal action indices. On mismatch or censoring, stop and report; never silently fall back to native searched opponent or terminal labels. Reuse the same Rust game rules and deterministic observation encoder.
implementation_verification: Expose native root completed-turn slate plans and static scores through an opt-in Python VectorEnv method; verify each local-index plan replays to the exact Rust candidate game and first static-best plan agrees with ordinary native search. Unit-test plan caching across atomic actions, terminal candidates, changing legal-action counts and map resets. Ordinary search/agent behavior must remain unchanged.

windows.disjointness: All windows are disjoint from every used training/diagnostic window and untouched final seed6300000. Do not run validation before pilot implementation/replay checks or confirmation if validation fails.

comparisons: Pilot and validation: hybrid versus plain native full-turn beam256 on matched maps, each side rotated across both seats; report complete game wins/draws, independent-map better/worse/same exact two-sided sign test, action-limit adjudication, per-seat outcomes, elapsed wall time and search/model decisions. Confirmation if validation passes: hybrid versus frozen routed-v6 direct and validated native reply-search teacher256/8/64 on fresh matched both-seat maps, with pool-relative Elo and map-bootstrap uncertainty. Never transfer Elo to other maps or multiplayer.
validation_gate: Advance only if all sampled root plans replay exactly, no hybrid reply is censored, no unexplained action-limit adjudication, hybrid beats plain beam256 on independent maps with two-sided exact sign p<0.05 and both seat strata have nonnegative win difference, and median hybrid decision wall time is below the native reply-search teacher's median measured on the same host/arena. A pilot failure stops before validation for localization.
promotion: Offline teacher root-choice agreement is diagnostic only. No rating or browser deployment until frozen hybrid passes independent confirmation and profile/runtime checks; even then report pool-relative Elo and exact map count, not universal strength. Reserve final seed6300000 for a later, already-gated candidate.
resource_limit: Heavy compute only SSH server after aggregate CPU/memory/disk inspection, one bounded nice19 CPU process and no GPU, pilot under15 minutes, validation and confirmation each under60 minutes, tiny JSON outputs/checkpoints, avoid other user workloads and private data. If resource pressure or runtime cap is reached, stop and report censoring rather than increasing parallelism.
